is responsible for many of the effects of carbohydrates in adipose tissue (Benhamed et al., 2015).
Although ChREBP responds to circulating levels of glucose, it was established early on that glucose metabolization was necessary
for regulation to occur. In most tissues, glucose enters by diffusion mediated by speciﬁc transporters called GLUT and once inside
the cell, it must be metabolized in order to exert its transcriptional regulatory activity. Since in liver the ﬁrst stage of glucose metab-
olism produces glucose-6-phosphate (G6P), this was initially proposed as the molecule responsible for glucose-mediated signaling
